preliminary_findings.title: Configuration-scoped domain calls may not propagate authenticated principal
Manual CRM create may default to active outreach without consent
CRM cursor may be unsigned and unbound
CRM assignee joins may lack active account/product membership scope
Privileged MFA recovery/factor management may lack recent step-up
Return-route validation may not reject login loops
Student resolver may select first active identity under corruption
Support preview may preserve learner free text
